name: ohurteach-workspace
description: A native Expert Team that turns one licensed source into a lesson plan, quiz and slide outline for Indonesian teachers, with rule-pack review and human approval before any publication.

displayDescription.en: Helps Indonesian teachers turn one licensed source into a lesson plan, quiz and slide outline. Every draft is checked against a versioned rule pack and waits for teacher approval.
displayDescription.zh: 面向印尼教师，把单一授权教材转成教案、测验与幻灯片大纲，规则审核把关，教师批准后才发布。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请把我提供的教材来源转成教案、测验和幻灯片大纲，并用印尼语与我沟通。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Turn the source material I provide into a lesson plan, quiz and slide outline, and communicate with me in Indonesian.

quickPrompts.en: Turn the source material I provide into a lesson plan, quiz and slide outline, and communicate with me in Indonesian.
quickPrompts.zh: 请把我提供的教材来源转成教案、测验和幻灯片大纲，并用印尼语与我沟通。

quickPrompts.en: Make a quiz only from my licensed material, with the teacher key kept separate from the student file.
quickPrompts.zh: 只用我授权的材料出一份测验，教师答案与学生文件分开保存。

quickPrompts.en: Fill my school template using a copy, and check layout before and after.
quickPrompts.zh: 用副本把内容填入学校模板，并检查填写前后的版式。
